title: Campus Accessibility Overview
content: IIT Hyderabad campus paths are primarily outdoor and paved. Ramps are available at the Administration Block, Library, Biomedical Engineering Building, and Medical Centre. Hostel H1's main entrance has stairs; use the step-free route via the Medical Centre side instead.

title: Emergency Contacts
content: For a medical emergency on campus, go to or contact the Medical Centre near the Main Gate. For campus security concerns, contact campus security at the Main Gate. In a life-threatening emergency, call 112 (India's national emergency number).

title: Medical Centre
content: The Medical Centre is located near the Main Gate and has a step-free, single-story entrance. It provides basic first aid and medical consultation for students and staff.

title: Campus Navigation Rules
content: Pedestrians should keep to marked paths where available. Vehicles have right of way on road crossings; listen carefully for traffic before crossing. This assistant supplements, but does not replace, your cane, guide dog, or orientation and mobility training.

title: Student Canteen
content: The Student Canteen is an open-air facility near the Library, offering snacks and meals throughout the day. For the current mess menu, ask the assistant for today's mess menu.

title: SNCC (Student Activity Centre)
content: SNCC is a large open hall used for student events, gatherings, and activities, located near the Administration Block.
